name: hatch-that-world
description: Build a cute app or daily page as a little drawn world: the data drawn as a scene (hills, a draggable sun, a mascot with moods), switchable worlds each light and dark with their own sounds, and clickable things in the drawing. Plus the build process that keeps it safe: an options page before building, and checks that can fail (copy text unchanged, other worlds pixel-identical, geometry and click tests), with three ready Playwright scripts.
